Saudi ToyotaChampionship

It's considered the largest motorsport championship in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, representing a qualitative shift in the world of local motorsport in terms of diversity, organization, and participation.

The championship includes a diverse range of motorsport categories

Karting

Karting

The perfect entry point into motorsport, building skills and passion for racing.

Autocross

Autocross

Technical tracks, tight corners and pure driving precision.

Time Attack

Time Attack

Pushing limits to set the fastest times on track.

Drift

Drift

Controlled slides, tyre smoke and style, judged on angle and precision.

Hill Climb

Hill Climb

Winding mountain roads and a race against the clock to the summit.

Off-Road

Off-Road

Rough desert terrain, big jumps and endurance that tests man and machine.

Esports

Esports

Sim racing on the virtual grid, where skill and reflexes decide the winner.
